name: dev-digest-toolkit
title: Dev Digest Toolkit
description: Skills, commands, and an agent for turning a batch of PRs into a readable digest.
author: AneliiaOleksiuk
body:
# Dev Digest Toolkit

A small set of tools for summarizing engineering activity: changelog entries from PR diffs, a digest command for weekly summaries, and an agent that drafts full release notes.

name: changelog-writer
title: Changelog Writer
description: Generates a changelog entry from a PR diff, following Keep a Changelog conventions.
author: AneliiaOleksiuk
body:
# Changelog Writer

Given a PR diff and title, this skill drafts a single changelog line: what changed and why, in the style already used in `CHANGELOG.md`. It infers the category (Added/Changed/Fixed/Removed) from the diff shape and asks for clarification only when the intent genuinely isn't clear from the code.

name: digest-summary
title: Digest Summary
description: Slash command that summarizes a date range of merged PRs into a short digest.
author: AneliiaOleksiuk
body:
# /digest-summary

Run `/digest-summary --since 2026-08-01` to get a grouped summary of merged PRs (features, fixes, chores) suitable for pasting into a team update.

name: release-notes-drafter
title: Release Notes Drafter
description: Custom agent that turns a milestone's closed issues and PRs into full release notes.
author: AneliiaOleksiuk
body:
# Release Notes Drafter

A sub-agent focused on release notes: reads every merged PR and closed issue tagged with a milestone, groups them, and writes a draft ready for a maintainer to review before publishing.

name: code-review-kit
title: Code Review Kit
description: Skills for explaining lint/security findings in plain language and drafting PR descriptions.
author: AneliiaOleksiuk
body:
# Code Review Kit

Two skills aimed at making code review faster: one explains what a security/lint finding actually means and how to fix it, the other drafts a PR description from the diff itself.

name: security-lint-explainer
title: Security Lint Explainer
description: Turns a raw security/lint finding into a plain-language explanation and a suggested fix.
author: AneliiaOleksiuk
body:
# Security Lint Explainer

Pastes a linter or SAST finding (e.g. from Semgrep, ESLint security rules) and gets back: why it's flagged, the realistic risk in this specific context, and a minimal fix.

name: pr-description-generator
title: PR Description Generator
description: Drafts a PR description (summary, test plan, risk notes) from the branch diff.
author: AneliiaOleksiuk
body:
# PR Description Generator

Reads the diff against the base branch and produces a PR description with a summary, a test plan checklist, and a callout for anything risky (schema changes, removed public APIs, etc.).

name: meeting-notes
title: Meeting Notes
description: A skill for pulling clear action items out of raw meeting notes or a transcript.
author: AneliiaOleksiuk
body:
# Meeting Notes

Early-stage plugin with a single skill: paste raw notes or a transcript, get back a clean list of action items with owners and due dates where they were stated.

name: action-item-extractor
title: Action Item Extractor
description: Extracts owners, due dates, and action items from raw meeting notes or a transcript.
author: AneliiaOleksiuk
body:
# Action Item Extractor

Given raw notes, returns a checklist: `- [ ] Owner — action — due date (if stated)`. Leaves due date blank rather than guessing when the notes don't say.
